t: You're on Grafton Street, in the City of Westminster. The street takes its name from Charles FitzRoy, the second Duke of Grafton, a British peer and politician. Lady Angela Forbes was born here. She was a socialite and novelist who became known as a forces sweetheart for organising soldiers' canteens in France during the First World War, and she went back to her maiden name in 1929. The barrister Amelius Francis Ward Beauclerk died here too.
